name: Early Click Buffer
description: Predicts wave collisions and delays your clicks by up to 20 frames so you survive. Shows how many frames it saved.

window-frames.name: Buffer Window (frames)
window-frames.description: Maximum frames a click can be delayed/buffered. 0 = off, max 20 (60 fps equivalent).

wave-assist.name: Wave Assist
wave-assist.description: Simulates the wave ahead and delays clicks that would make you crash.

ground-assist.name: Cube/Ball/Robot/Spider Assist
ground-assist.description: Buffers early clicks until you can jump or touch an orb.

show-indicator.name: Show Saved Frames
show-indicator.description: Shows how many frames the mod saved you.

debug-log.name: Debug Log
debug-log.description: Writes decisions to the Geode log (useful for bug reports).
